name: research-librarian
description: Karpathy-style LLM wiki for research papers. Ingest a URL / arXiv ID / DOI / PDF, write a structured summary into a local Obsidian vault, and maintain a finding-level knowledge graph via wikilinks + Dataview.

vault_path.title: Obsidian Vault Path
vault_path.description: Local directory for the research vault. Created by /research-librarian:init if it does not exist.

open_in_obsidian.title: Open new pages in Obsidian after ingest
open_in_obsidian.description: If true, ingest opens the new paper page via the obsidian:// URI scheme.

model_normal.title: Normal model
model_normal.description: Model for fast parallel subagents (finding-extractor, finding-linker, metadata-extractor). Defaults to Claude Haiku. To use Ollama instead, set this to an Ollama model name (e.g. llama3.2) and export ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://localhost:11434/v1 in your shell.

model_reasoning.title: Reasoning model
model_reasoning.description: Model for lite-drafter (critique and critical-thinking steps). Defaults to Claude Sonnet. To use Ollama instead, set this to an Ollama model name (e.g. qwen2.5:14b) and export ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://localhost:11434/v1 in your shell.
